channel.title: WIBU-SYSTEMS AG — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by WIBU-SYSTEMS AG (wibu).

item.title: CVE-2026-81581 · 8.8 HIGH — User input in WibuKey is used (without proper sanitization) to compute the address of a pointer, which can be exploited to let the user point to any storage, to which Windows responds with a denial of service.
item.description: Improper validation of memory boundaries in WibuKey64.sys of WibuKey up to 6.70 for Windows can be exploited by an attacker by setting the pointers outside the scope of the program. This usually results in a denial of service, yet we cannot rule out…

item.title: CVE-2026-81579 · 8.8 HIGH — An untrusted Pointer Dereference can be exploited to escalate privileges by an unprivileged user on Windows
item.description: In WibuKey for Windows before version 6.71, an untrusted pointer dereference in the WibuKey2_64.sys kernel driver for 64-bit Windows allows an attacker to exploit a write-what-where primitive, enabling local privilege escalation. This can be leverage…

item.title: CVE-2026-81576 · 7.7 HIGH — Improper Authentication of Session Handles
item.description: If configured as a server, CodeMeter Runtime before versions 8.41a and 9.10 issues handles per connection and relies on a cryptographically weak SID as sole authenticator. An attacker can brute-force the SID, recover another session's handle number,…

item.title: CVE-2026-81575 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Missing Sanity Checks for Buffer Lengths
item.description: If configured as a server, CodeMeter Runtime before versions 8.41a and 9.10 accepts requests with opcode 0x5e, which contain the data length and the data itself. Missing bounds checking on the data length value can lead to out of bounds reads, causin…

item.title: CVE-2026-81574 · 8.2 HIGH 🌩️ — Format String Vulnerability in Logger
item.description: In CodeMeter Runtime before versions 8.41a and 9.10, the logger does not sanitize input strings in certain cases, allowing an attacker to inject printf-style format specifiers. This can be used to reliably crash CodeMeter and disclose sensitive infor…

item.title: CVE-2026-81573 · 8.6 HIGH 🌩️ — Improper Access Control in Local-Only Configuration Commands
item.description: If CodeMeter Runtime before 8.41a or 9.10 is configured as a server, the configuration command handler does not enforce network- origin restrictions. Commands intended only for local or same-network clients can therefore be executed by arbitrary remo…

item.title: CVE-2026-81572 · 7.8 HIGH — Local Privilege Escalation in CodeMeter Runtime on Windows
